hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty"); case "$f" in *.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; out=$(uv run ruff check --fix -q "$f" 2>&1); status=$?; uv run ruff format -q "$f" 2>&1 >&2; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac
